description: Speaking at Moneycontrol Startup Conclave, chief secretary Shalini Rajneesh said Karnataka is using AI to provide personalised crop advisories to farmers and is working on applications to track produce across the value chain
body_lead: Karnataka is stepping up the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in agriculture, with state government working on applications that can track crops from the farm to the consumer, chief secretary Shalini Rajneesh has said. Speaking at Moneycontrol Startup Conclave, Rajneesh said agriculture is among the key sectors where the state is looking to expand AI applications. The government has also launched an Agritech Mission as part of its 100-day programme.
